# Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level

> What each Claude model (Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) costs at every effort level, and which gives the best quality for the price. Open data, CC BY 4.0.

Best value overall: Sonnet 5.5 at medium effort, 5.0× cheaper than the price trend for its quality (expected score 60.9 % on the benchmark panel, cost 1.1× the cheapest couple). Best pick by task tier: grunt work → Sonnet 5.5 at medium effort; everyday tasks → Sonnet 5.5 at high effort; advanced reasoning → Sonnet 5.5 at high effort; cutting-edge thinking → Opus 5.5 at high effort. Highest measured quality: Opus 5.5 at max effort (expected score 75.7 %, cost 19× the cheapest couple).

Costs are multiples of the cheapest couple's; quality is the expected score on the benchmark panel. Both are fused from measurements taken on the same task by a latent-quality model that estimates each benchmark's own scale (method: docs/METHODOLOGY.md in the source repository), from 185 sources · 548 benchmarks · 3758 measurements. Updated 2026-09-30. Figures are indicative, derived from public third-party measurements; not affiliated with Anthropic.

## Report

- [Claude models compared: cost vs quality at every effort level](https://claude-models.agensse.com/): quality vs cost per model and effort level, Pareto frontier, best pick per task tier, normalized cost matrix, method and sources.
- [Fable vs Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Claude models head-to-head](https://claude-models.agensse.com/claude-models-head-to-head.html): every pair of Claude models compared effort by effort, and the cheapest effort of each that matches the other.

## Head-to-head

- Fable 5.1 vs Opus 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 1.4× to 3.2× what Opus 5.5 costs and scores between 4.5 points lower and 0.2 points higher on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (72.0 %, cost 26×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (71.8 %, cost 3.5×): 7.5× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (75.7 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 72.0 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 1.9× to 7.7× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores between 2.5 points lower and 9.0 points higher on the benchmark panel. To match Fable 5.1 at max (72.0 %, cost 26×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is xHigh (72.6 %, cost 4.0×): 6.6× cheaper per task. No Fable 5.1 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (74.5 %): Fable 5.1's best is max at 72.0 %.
- Fable 5.1 vs Haiku 4.5: Haiku 4.5 is measured at a single setting, with no effort levels, so the two are compared through their cheapest matches. No Haiku 4.5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (72.0 %): Haiku 4.5's best is its only setting at 37.2 %. To match Haiku 4.5 (37.2 %, cost 1.2×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is low (65.2 %, cost 7.1×): 5.7× dearer per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Sonnet 5.5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 1.3× to 3.2× what Sonnet 5.5 costs and scores 1.3 to 10.9 points higher on the benchmark panel. To match Opus 5.5 at max (75.7 %, cost 19×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is max (74.5 %, cost 14×): 1.3× cheaper per task. To match Sonnet 5.5 at max (74.5 %, cost 14×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is high (73.4 %, cost 4.2×): 3.3× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Haiku 4.5: Haiku 4.5 is measured at a single setting, with no effort levels, so the two are compared through their cheapest matches. No Haiku 4.5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (75.7 %): Haiku 4.5's best is its only setting at 37.2 %. To match Haiku 4.5 (37.2 %, cost 1.2×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is low (65.0 %, cost 2.2×): 1.8× dearer per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Haiku 4.5: Haiku 4.5 is measured at a single setting, with no effort levels, so the two are compared through their cheapest matches. No Haiku 4.5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (74.5 %): Haiku 4.5's best is its only setting at 37.2 %. To match Haiku 4.5 (37.2 %, cost 1.2×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is low (56.2 %, cost 1.0×): 1.2× cheaper per task.
- Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Fable 5.1 costs 0.9× to 1.1× what Fable 5 costs and scores 2.1 to 4.4 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Fable 5 setting reaches Fable 5.1 at max (72.0 %): Fable 5's best is max at 69.4 %. To match Fable 5 at max (69.4 %, cost 24×), the cheapest Fable 5.1 setting is high (68.9 %, cost 10×): 2.4× cheaper per task.
- Opus 5.5 vs Opus 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Opus 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.4× what Opus 5 costs and scores 1.6 to 5.1 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Opus 5 setting reaches Opus 5.5 at max (75.7 %): Opus 5's best is max at 70.6 %. To match Opus 5 at max (70.6 %, cost 13×), the cheapest Opus 5.5 setting is medium (71.8 %, cost 3.5×): 3.8× cheaper per task.
- Sonnet 5.5 vs Sonnet 5: At the same effort (low, medium, high, xHigh, max), Sonnet 5.5 costs 0.5× to 1.4× what Sonnet 5 costs and scores 9.9 to 14.7 points higher on the benchmark panel. No Sonnet 5 setting reaches Sonnet 5.5 at max (74.5 %): Sonnet 5's best is max at 59.7 %. To match Sonnet 5 at max (59.7 %, cost 9.8×), the cheapest Sonnet 5.5 setting is medium (60.9 %, cost 1.1×): 8.8× cheaper per task. Sonnet 5's cost is size-sensitive: a verbose model, its cost swings widely between short and long agentic tasks, hence its wide interval.

- [raw-data.csv](https://claude-models.agensse.com/raw-data.csv): every measured row (source, model, effort, task, harness, cost, tokens, score, reference), CC BY 4.0.
